notes.title: Demo version has been released!
notes.notes:
The demo version of "Rainbow Sea" has been released in conjunction with the Steam Next Fest!

Please post your impressions of the trial version and any bugs you find in this thread.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1695000/discussions/

■About the demo version
The demo version allows you to play the same game content as the full version for 90 minutes.
In order to allow you to enjoy the game within the time limit, there is a feature that allows you to select your favorite character at the beginning of the game, which will facilitate the display of hints for that character.
We hope you will take this opportunity to play this game and enjoy the world of “Rainbow Sea”.

■About supported languages
Currently, the demo version supports “Japanese,” “English,” and “Korean,” but both the demo version and the full version will support “Simplified Chinese” and “Traditional Chinese” in future updates.

■About live streaming and fan fiction
We welcome live streaming and fan fiction of both the demo version and the full version of “Rainbow Sea”, provided that everyone follows the rules.
For more information, please see the link below.

【"Rainbow Sea" guideline】
 https://shirokurohitsuji.studio/2024/06/01/rainbowsea-guideline/
